description: Look up Brazil's official statistics from IBGE, the national statistics institute. Find states and municipalities with their IBGE codes and regions; see how common a first name is by decade and state; follow IBGE's news, new figures and release calendar; search and fetch any SIDRA statistics table, such as population estimates or IPCA inflation; compare countries on IBGE's indicators; and look up CNAE business activity codes. Everything reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
